Qué cuenta cada número: vínculos biológicos y resultados experimentales

Unidad: celdas (familia o intervención × necesidad) de la matriz; los niveles nunca se suman y ninguno es una proporción de la enfermedad tratada.

  • Vínculo biológico: diana de la intervención documentada para la necesidad (asociación): 2.381
  • Coherencia mecanicista: dirección coherente con la necesidad / opuesta / dirección sin resolver: 74 / 11 / 595
  • Efecto observado, de los cuales en un sistema WWOX: 10 (8)
  • Recuperación observada en un sistema WWOX, de los cuales experimental: 4 (3)

Una proporción de vías biológicas o de dianas vinculadas no es una proporción de la enfermedad tratada: un vínculo de diana es una asociación documentada, no una predicción direccional ni un efecto observado.

No se muestra ninguna probabilidad clínica calibrada, porque ninguna ha sido validada; el percentil del modelo no se muestra en absoluto.

Imprimir esta sección (A4)

Hipótesis comparadas: prioridad de investigación, posición del modelo y evidencia observada

Nueve hipótesis que cubren los dos objetivos de investigación y varios tipos de intervención, elegidas por cobertura y no por mérito. Tres cosas permanecen separadas, en bloques distintos: la prioridad de investigación (posición F, C o P y motivo del plan de verificaciones: indica adónde llevar el próximo estudio, no si el fármaco funciona), la posición del modelo y la evidencia observada en un sistema WWOX. Ninguna puntuación combinada, ningún orden.

Posición del modelo: qué dice de esta hipótesis la comparación de métodos (la prueba predictiva, más abajo). Hoy no aporta ningún elemento positivo para ninguna de las nueve: «ninguna posición» significa no evaluada, no rechazada, y «ninguna ventaja demostrada» se refiere a un método sobre el subconjunto piloto, nunca a un compuesto.

Clave de las letras: F hipótesis favorable, C contraevidencia por aclarar, P premisa ausente; el número indica de dónde procede el respaldo (1 controlado en un sistema WWOX, 2 tenue en WWOX, 3 desde la diana o desde otra enfermedad). Son posiciones, no un orden.

El texto científico de los bloques está en inglés, como en la comparación original. Las concentraciones y los porcentajes citados de las fuentes describen estudios externos: no son una guía de dosis y no son evidencia WWOX. No se muestra ninguna probabilidad clínica calibrada, porque ninguna ha sido validada; el percentil del modelo no se muestra en absoluto.

4-phenylbutyrate class and bile-acid chemical chaperones CMP-01

Prioridad de investigación

4-phenylbutyrate class and bile-acid chemical chaperones A01_pba_class F3 sobre la necesidad Rescatar una proteína WWOX desestabilizada por una variante de sentido erróneo del dominio SDR
Plan de verificaciones: resolver una premisa Rescatar una proteína WWOX desestabilizada por una variante de sentido erróneo del dominio SDR

Posición del modelo

ninguna posición del modelo para esta hipótesis

  • Excluido a propósito de la comparación de métodos porque tiene una ficha curada (así la comparación no podía ajustarse a los compuestos ya discutidos).
  • Fuera de la pregunta de la comparación, que se refería a un módulo de transcritos glucólisis/lactato: las proteínas, los receptores y la glía no eran su objeto.

Evidencia observada en un sistema WWOX

None for the intervention in any WWOX system. The lesion side: one patient-fibroblast blot (one membrane, one exposure) shows transcript comparable to reference lines and no detectable protein band; fractions not separated.

Detalles: contexto, evidencia favorable, contraria y ausente, próximo experimento
Track y genotipo
Track B: lesion-specific, a Q230P-class missense with residual protein; no meaning for null, nonsense or splice lesions
Profundidad del beneficio buscado
deep: function per molecule of the rescued protein; a larger amount of protein is not function and is not read as rescue
Favorable: premisa demostrada
Other proteins: chemical chaperone or osmolyte raised a destabilised mutant with protein and function read together in some cases (GAT-1 variant; a soluble cytosolic client roughly doubled in soluble fraction). All are outside WWOX.
Contraria: efectos opuestos o contraevidencia
Wild-type protein rises too (not mutant-specific); partly trafficked variant not rescued by the class in one precedent; butyrate raised immature total protein with small function gain; toxicity ceiling near 4 mM in one paper; HDAC inhibition is quantitatively available at the applied levels and could be the operating mechanism, with transcriptional side effects.
Ausente: premisa no demostrada
Where the Q230P-class protein is lost (never made, cleared, insoluble, epitope-invisible); any per-molecule WWOX function assay; whether the lesion is a stability lesion; which of three mechanism classes (chaperoning, HDAC6/HSP90 acetylation, class-I HDAC transcription) operates.
Precedentes externos (no son evidencia WWOX)
Several cell, worm, fly, zebrafish and short mouse precedents in other proteins: cards record complete or partial full-text reads for the R1 papers; no WWOX test. Rationale was withdrawn once in this repository and narrowed, not refuted (IT5 P8).
Próximo experimento
Build the wild-type function ruler first: isogenic WWOX-null human neural line, wild-type WWOX titrated over at least five levels with a Tier 1 WW1-dependent readout and measured protein; then place the Q230P-class allele on the curve; only then a lever panel (class-I HDAC inhibitor; HDAC6-selective or pan-HDAC; HDAC-free chaperone and osmolytes) with mRNA flat and the null line unaffected as conditions. Outcomes fixed in advance in the card.
Estado del experimento
PROPOSED, not run; no measurement of this kind exists in the repository; its absence does not block the computational work

Proteasome-inhibitor class CMP-02

Prioridad de investigación

Proteasome-inhibitor class A02_proteasome_inhibitor_class F3 sobre la necesidad Rescatar una proteína WWOX desestabilizada por una variante de sentido erróneo del dominio SDR
Plan de verificaciones: resolver una premisa Rescatar una proteína WWOX desestabilizada por una variante de sentido erróneo del dominio SDR

Posición del modelo

ninguna posición del modelo para esta hipótesis

  • Fuera de la pregunta de la comparación, que se refería a un módulo de transcritos glucólisis/lactato: las proteínas, los receptores y la glía no eran su objeto.

Evidencia observada en un sistema WWOX

None for the intervention. No fractionation, half-life, inhibitor or synthesis datum exists for the exact variant.

Detalles: contexto, evidencia favorable, contraria y ausente, próximo experimento
Track y genotipo
Track B: Q230P-class missense that is a proteasome substrate; a lysosomal route would make it ineffective; no meaning for null lesions
Profundidad del beneficio buscado
deep only if stabilisation suffices; stabilisation without refolding is expected to raise inactive or insoluble protein for catalytic or folding lesions
Favorable: premisa demostrada
Cytosolic enzyme precedent (CBS): proteasome inhibition restored activity in vivo for a regulatory-domain allele and partly for catalytic-domain alleles; the route can be resolved per allele. Not WWOX.
Contraria: efectos opuestos o contraevidencia
Gain applies to wild type too (CBS wild-type half-life up about 7.7-fold); immune toxicity and toxic windows in controls; a heat-shock response confounds the readout; allele-selective failure (one allele not rescued in the mouse).
Ausente: premisa no demostrada
That the Q230P-class protein is made and then cleared by the proteasome (the repository red-team record expects a lysosomal route); that recovered protein is functional; a safe exposure window.
Precedentes externos (no son evidencia WWOX)
CBS and ASPA precedents read at the passages the card cites (IT6 P6, 17 statements checked): boost without repair, insoluble stabilised protein (ASPA), protein up with activity flat (CBS with HSP70 or HSF1 co-expression), toxic windows including in controls.
Próximo experimento
Route-first fate experiment on the exact variant in an expression-matched WWOX-null human system: soluble, pellet and total protein, mRNA in the same wells, pulse-chase half-life, proteasome, lysosome and ERAD arms side by side each on the ruler line and the null line with a viability readout. No protein with synthesis present closes this card for the allele.
Estado del experimento
PROPOSED, not run; no measurement of this kind exists in the repository; its absence does not block the computational work

Plan de verificaciones: verificare un'ipotesi Restaurar la proteína WWOX en las neuronas mediante la adición del gen
Plan de verificaciones: chiarire una controevidenza Descompensación metabólica sistémica

Posición del modelo

ninguna posición del modelo para esta hipótesis

  • No es un compuesto con una fila de diana: el método de red no se aplica.

Evidencia observada en un sistema WWOX

Wwox-null mouse, vector given P0 to P5: spike-wave discharges not distinguishable from wild type at the high level (blinded, n 5); survival to 300 days at the high level comparable to the wild-type arm, the low level postpones death; weight equal at one age but survivor-conditioned; glucose unchanged; myelination dose relation never quantified; gliosis binary against wild type. Organoid AAV9-WWOX at week 10: hyperexcitability and transcript-level changes read at week 16 against non-treated organoids (not vector-treated).

Detalles: contexto, evidencia favorable, contraria y ausente, próximo experimento
Track y genotipo
Track A: allele-blind in design (replaces the missing gene product); tested only in a null mouse; response in a missense or compound context with residual function is unmeasured
Profundidad del beneficio buscado
deep: multi-endpoint restoration; shown for prevention in an early window, not for recovery after onset (one organoid endpoint aside)
Favorable: premisa demostrada
Prevention of the null phenotype by neuronal WWOX in the earliest postnatal window, in the strongest causal design of the corpus; neuron-restricted deletion reproduces the phenotype and neuron-restricted replacement reverses it.
Contraria: efectos opuestos o contraevidencia
Over-expression of a pro-apoptotic tumour suppressor with no ceiling measured and no surveillance; regionally uneven biodistribution; glucose endpoints null beside weight benefit (C2 on that need); wild-type arm itself lost about 29 percent by 300 days.
Ausente: premisa no demostrada
Treatment after onset (mouse: unmeasured after P5); threshold versus steep continuum (two dose points); independent replication (two papers share a senior author); transfer to missense or compound alleles; tumour surveillance for an irreversibly delivered pro-apoptotic tumour suppressor; absolute vector quantity (uncertain by a factor of two in the source).
Precedentes externos (no son evidencia WWOX)
The two mouse papers and the organoid paper are the only sources; the survival and motor comparators were re-read at the source in IT6 P2; the organoid single-cell data are deposited but not accessible. No other gene-addition precedent is used.
Próximo experimento
An intermediate-level arm (a fraction of the high level) carried to 300 days with survival, weight, glucose, ECoG and quantified myelin in the same animals, plus a pre-treatment baseline and treated-after-onset arms with a same-age untreated comparator. A failure moves the card to C2 by rule; a treated-after-onset arm decides whether the word recovery may be used.
Estado del experimento
PROPOSED, not run; no measurement of this kind exists in the repository; its absence does not block the computational work; needs a laboratory holding the vector, none known here

Comparación de métodos sobre el eje glucólisis/lactato: ninguna ventaja demostrada, exploratorio Se refiere a los métodos de ordenación sobre el subconjunto piloto, no es un juicio sobre el compuesto: para este compuesto el modelo no da ninguna posición.

Los compuestos están en el censo de los utilizables (tienen la entrada que requiere un método) pero no han sido evaluados.

Evidencia observada en un sistema WWOX

Transcript level only: LDHA higher in the knockout organoid and in shRNA progenitors (one library per arm); lactate and LDH activity higher in a human knockout fibroblast line; fly Ldh RNAi improved climbing once in an amyloid plus Wwox-reduction genotype (no Ldh-alone arm, no lactate readout). Human lactate in WWOX deficiency reported normal or extremely low in other sources. No compound has been given to any WWOX-deficient system on this need.

Detalles: contexto, evidencia favorable, contraria y ausente, próximo experimento
Track y genotipo
Track A: allele-blind downstream metabolic lever; whether the axis is preserved in a catalytic-domain missense allele is an inference only
Profundidad del beneficio buscado
partial: a metabolic consequence, not restoration of WWOX; no endpoint benefit is claimed
Favorable: premisa demostrada
LDHA transcript raised in two human neural transcript systems; HK and LDH activity raised in one human fibroblast line.
Contraria: efectos opuestos o contraevidencia
Stiripentol also inhibits mitochondrial complex I (isolated mouse heart and liver mitochondria, from tens of uM), so a metabolic effect is not an LDH effect and may recruit the integrated stress response; Ldh knockdown is detrimental in other fly amyloid models (authors' own citation); LDHB is the discordant gene in the P3 transfer test.
Ausente: premisa no demostrada
LDH activity or lactate in WWOX-deficient human neural cells at matched maturity; that the elevation is not maturity or integrated-stress-response driven; that the candidate engages LDH in brain.
Precedentes externos (no son evidencia WWOX)
Rico-Molina 2024 read in part (inhibition data), Bacq 2024 review opened at the pharmacokinetic passage; Sada 2015 not lawfully acquirable (abstract and secondary descriptions only). Nedosiran shows LDHA lowering tolerated in liver.
Próximo experimento
Lactate (isotope or enantiomer resolved) and LDH activity, LDHA and LDHB separately, in WWOX-deficient versus isogenic human neural cells at matched maturity, with phospho-eIF2 alpha and ATF4 read beside LDH; the fly Ldh-alone arm; only then stiripentol against a selective LDHA tool at matched exposure. If lactate is not raised the need loses its WWOX observation and the card moves to P3 by rule.
Estado del experimento
PROPOSED, not run; no measurement of this kind exists in the repository; its absence does not block the computational work

Detalles: contexto, evidencia favorable, contraria y ausente, próximo experimento
Track y genotipo
Track A: allele-blind in design; WWOX binds HIF1A through WW1, so the axis may be partly preserved in an SDR missense allele (inference)
Profundidad del beneficio buscado
partial: a metabolic and possibly symptomatic effect; the card pursues no benefit endpoint and sharpens a decision
Favorable: premisa demostrada
The glycolytic end of the chain (LDHA, a HIF-type gene set) is raised in two human neural transcript systems; PDK-PDH restraint is documented after chemoconvulsant seizures in two non-WWOX epilepsy models.
Contraria: efectos opuestos o contraevidencia
Lowers glucose in adults and gluconeogenic precursors while hypoglycaemia is the Wwox-null phenotype (sign in a hypoglycaemic pup unmeasured); peripheral neuropathy is dose-limiting in adults; urinary oxalate +22 percent in a long-term cohort; rodent hepatotoxicity and neoplasia at high chronic doses; the general mechanism is self-inhibition of its own metabolism (GSTZ1), so exposure rises with repeated administration and varies with haplotype and age, whereas the one paediatric kinetic cohort (17 children) plateaued rather than accumulating - the two statements come from different sources and are not reconciled here; a slight pro-convulsant signal in one test.
Ausente: premisa no demostrada
That PDH is restrained in a WWOX-deficient neural system and that the restraint is WWOX-dependent rather than seizure-secondary; the direction of the glucose response in a hypoglycaemic young animal.
Precedentes externos (no son evidencia WWOX)
Paediatric congenital lactic acidosis randomized trial (lactate moved, no clinical outcome in six months), a long-term follow-up, a MELAS trial stopped early for neuropathy; the one seizure-endpoint test in a PDH-restrained model was negative (abstract level, closed); several of these at abstract or review level only.
Próximo experimento
In WWOX-deficient human neural cells against matched controls: PDHA1 Ser293 phosphorylation with total PDH, PDH activity and a glucose tracer into acetyl-CoA, citrate and lactate, then with a PDK inhibitor against vehicle reading the genotype-by-inhibitor interaction (free DCA exposure and a second inhibitor of different chemistry as controls).
Estado del experimento
PROPOSED, not run; no measurement of this kind exists in the repository; its absence does not block the computational work; cell access depends on a deposit that needs an access request that exists as a draft only and is not filed

Ketogenic and lactate-transport interventions · Ketogenic diet CMP-06

Ketogenic and lactate-transport interventions E04_ketogenic_lactate_axis P1 sobre la necesidad Entrada del piruvato en el ciclo de Krebs
Ketogenic diet EB-KD-01 P3 sobre la necesidad Entrada del piruvato en el ciclo de Krebs C2 sobre la necesidad Control de crisis y espasmos como necesidad sintomática
Plan de verificaciones: verificare un'ipotesi Entrada del piruvato en el ciclo de Krebs
Plan de verificaciones: chiarire una controevidenza Control de crisis y espasmos como necesidad sintomática

Posición del modelo

ninguna posición del modelo para esta hipótesis

  • No es un compuesto con una fila de diana: el método de red no se aplica.

Evidencia observada en un sistema WWOX

One severe case lists the ketogenic diet among ineffective interventions; four sources report normal human metabolism in WWOX deficiency and one brain spectroscopy report has lactate extremely low. The fly lactate result is amyloid-conditional and cannot be used for or against the direction in WWOX-null neurons.

Detalles: contexto, evidencia favorable, contraria y ausente, próximo experimento
Track y genotipo
Track A: allele-blind in design; mechanism for WWOX UNKNOWN
Profundidad del beneficio buscado
partial: empirical seizure control; any bypass of a bioenergetic defect is hypothetical
Favorable: premisa demostrada
Ketogenic diet is an established empirical epilepsy treatment in general (card: empirical seizure-control use); nothing demonstrated for WWOX.
Contraria: efectos opuestos o contraevidencia
A ketone bypass would act without reactivating PDH, so it cannot test the PDK-PDH link; hypoglycaemia is the Wwox-null phenotype and a dietary intervention changes glucose supply (direction in this model UNKNOWN); human metabolic screens reported normal where done.
Ausente: premisa no demostrada
Whether a WWOX-deficient human neural cell has a bioenergetic defect a ketone substrate would bypass; whether lactate is raised, normal or low in WWOX-deficient brain across ages.
Precedentes externos (no son evidencia WWOX)
General epilepsy use; no precedent was re-read for this comparison and the card records three earlier depths, not repeated.
Próximo experimento
PDH-specific readouts in WWOX-deficient human neural cells or the existing knockout organoids against isogenic controls: PDH activity in a phosphorylation-preserving lysate, phospho-PDHA1 Ser293, 13C-glucose or ketone tracing, pyruvate-to-lactate ratio, NADH/NAD+. Seahorse alone is a screen and not a PDH measure.
Estado del experimento
PROPOSED, not run; no measurement of this kind exists in the repository; its absence does not block the computational work

NMDAR intervention class for the neuron-specific Wwox bursting phenotype CMP-07

Prioridad de investigación

NMDAR intervention class for the neuron-specific Wwox bursting phenotype F04_nmdar_intervention_class F3 sobre la necesidad Ganancia excitatoria de red y descargas en ráfagas
Plan de verificaciones: verificare un'ipotesi Ganancia excitatoria de red y descargas en ráfagas

Posición del modelo

ninguna posición del modelo para esta hipótesis

  • Excluido a propósito de la comparación de métodos porque tiene una ficha curada (así la comparación no podía ajustarse a los compuestos ya discutidos).
  • Fuera de la pregunta de la comparación, que se refería a un módulo de transcritos glucólisis/lactato: las proteínas, los receptores y la glía no eran su objeto.

Los compuestos están en el censo de los utilizables (tienen la entrada que requiere un método) pero no han sido evaluados.

Evidencia observada en un sistema WWOX

Neuron-specific knockout cortical slice (single paper): d-APV abolishes bursting (5 slices from 3 animals, no significance marker in the figure) and the delayed evoked response; sEPSC about 6 percent higher; sIPSC amplitude 27.5 against 57.3 pA (the larger change is inhibitory); hippocampal slices do not burst. No memantine, ketamine, GluN2B modulator or AMPAR antagonist was applied in a WWOX system.

Detalles: contexto, evidencia favorable, contraria y ausente, próximo experimento
Track y genotipo
Track A: acts on a network state whatever the allele; the one electrophysiology source is a neuron-specific knockout, so missense lesions are untested
Profundidad del beneficio buscado
partial: reduction of a network state (bursting); the card says no developmental benefit is implied
Favorable: premisa demostrada
Bursting needs NMDAR activity in this slice; the knockout rests more depolarised than wild type.
Contraria: efectos opuestos o contraevidencia
Selfotel failed with a harm signal in adults; NMDAR blockade in the developing rat brain triggers apoptosis (abstract level); memantine accelerated seizure stages in an adult rat oxygen model; perampanel carries a boxed warning for psychiatric and behavioural reactions; sustained NMDAR dampening may affect activity-dependent myelination (F02) in a developing brain; AMPAR block can abolish bursts without discriminating the NMDAR sign.
Ausente: premisa no demostrada
NMDAR gain (versus permissive dependence on depolarisation and weak inhibition); the fraction of NMDAR current that must be blocked; the recording-bath Mg2+; any subunit data; that the finding extends beyond cortex slice or to other alleles.
Precedentes externos (no son evidencia WWOX)
GluN2B negative modulators effective at more than 80 percent of the 27 tested gain-of-function GRIN variants in vitro (abstract only; source form); memantine improvement in any domain in a GRIN series 14 of 19 gain-of-function against 3 of 15 other (partial read; seizure-frequency difference not significant); selfotel stopped in adult stroke and head injury trials. All in gain-of-function disease, where the sign is known.
Próximo experimento
Step E1 in the source preparation (neuron-specific knockout, littermates, P13 to P17, layer II/III): isolated NMDAR current under voltage control with AMPAR and GABA-A blocked, amplitude, decay, NMDA:AMPA ratio, GluN2B and GluN2A shares, resting potential; then d-APV and a GluN2B tool concentration-response on the isolated current, the delayed response and bursts; a pore blocker only afterwards as a translation probe with Mg2+ and holding potential stated.
Estado del experimento
PROPOSED, not run; no measurement of this kind exists in the repository; its absence does not block the computational work; the knockout line is not held here

Extracellular magnesium as the physiological voltage-dependent NMDAR gate CMP-08

Prioridad de investigación

Extracellular magnesium as the physiological voltage-dependent NMDAR gate P11_magnesium_nmdar_gate P3 sobre la necesidad Ganancia excitatoria de red y descargas en ráfagas
Plan de verificaciones: verificare un'ipotesi Ganancia excitatoria de red y descargas en ráfagas

Posición del modelo

ninguna posición del modelo para esta hipótesis

  • No es un compuesto con una fila de diana: el método de red no se aplica.

Evidencia observada en un sistema WWOX

None for magnesium: no WWOX measurement of Mg2+, NMDAR current or block was found (zero hits for WWOX with magnesium in the searches run). The convergent WWOX observations are the d-APV result, a resting potential of -73.62 mV in knockout against -79.25 mV in wild type, and halved inhibitory current amplitude.

Detalles: contexto, evidencia favorable, contraria y ausente, próximo experimento
Track y genotipo
Track A: allele-blind; Track B unmeasured
Profundidad del beneficio buscado
partial at best: a reduction of a network state; no developmental benefit implied
Favorable: premisa demostrada
The knockout slice bursts in a medium whose incubation solution contains 1.3 mM Mg2+ (so the bursting is probably not a magnesium-free artefact; the recording bath is not stated, which is an inference).
Contraria: efectos opuestos o contraevidencia
Sustained NMDAR dampening may affect activity-dependent myelination or synaptic maturation in a developing brain (unmeasured); a graded rise in an ion that is already present removes only part of the residual conductance while d-APV removes all; one case on vitamin B6 and zonisamide without relief is recorded as counter-data for a related nutrient strand.
Ausente: premisa no demostrada
That the burst depends on the Mg2+ block; that a reachable Mg2+ rise lowers bursts without altering wild-type activity; that any preparation raises brain extracellular free Mg2+ in a child; serum and CSF Mg in WWOX-DEE.
Precedentes externos (no son evidencia WWOX)
Infantile spasms: intravenous magnesium sulfate with ACTH outperformed ACTH alone in 38 infants (abstract only); an open-label trial with an oral phase (48 analysed, both arms on ACTH and antiseizure drugs) found no difference (p 0.69). One mouse study read: oral magnesium sulfate raised serum Mg and left CSF Mg unchanged; the threonate raised CSF Mg by about a third in healthy mice (six per subgroup).
Próximo experimento
Graded bath Mg2+ around the slice value, in both directions, in knockout, heterozygote and wild-type neocortical slices at P13 to P17 in the source medium, then d-APV as ceiling; endpoints burst incidence, frequency, duration and amplitude, plus NMDA:AMPA ratio; in parallel total and ionised Mg in serum and CSF of knockout against control mice and the CSF response to one oral preparation. A rise that cannot lower bursts inside a reachable range closes the strand.
Estado del experimento
PROPOSED, not run; no measurement of this kind exists in the repository; its absence does not block the computational work; slice electrophysiology line not held here

Posición del modelo

ninguna posición del modelo para esta hipótesis

  • Fuera de la pregunta de la comparación, que se refería a un módulo de transcritos glucólisis/lactato: las proteínas, los receptores y la glía no eran su objeto.

Los compuestos están en el censo de los utilizables (tienen la entrada que requiere un método) pero no han sido evaluados.

Evidencia observada en un sistema WWOX

Gliosis raised in the null mouse and the P47T homozygote and returned toward baseline by neuron-restricted replacement (GFAP-positive cells about 44 to about 5); the opposite sign in a Wwox-mutant rat cortex (about half the GFAP and Iba1 cells from PND 5); the human organoid shows no reactive programme and has no microglia. No modulator given to any WWOX system.

Detalles: contexto, evidencia favorable, contraria y ausente, próximo experimento
Track y genotipo
Track A: allele-blind in design; no glial datum exists in a catalytic-domain missense allele
Profundidad del beneficio buscado
partial: protection or symptom relief downstream of neuronal loss; the causal compartment is neuronal, so a glial drug is not expected to touch the cause
Favorable: premisa demostrada
Glial change accompanies the phenotype in several mouse models and tracks rescue; a neuron-restricted deletion also shows astrocyte-activation-type genes, so glial change occurs without an astrocyte-intrinsic lesion.
Contraria: efectos opuestos o contraevidencia
If glial reactivity is protective or maturational in a developing Wwox-deficient brain (the rat sign), suppression could harm; the same neuron-restricted rescue that lowers GFAP also stops seizures, so the data cannot assign the fall to a glial route; long-term disability persists after acute control in the human precedents.
Ausente: premisa no demostrada
The sign of the glial difference before the first spike; whether glia are upstream of any harm; species versus allele versus region versus age as the source of the sign conflict; any astrocyte-specific deletion result.
Precedentes externos (no son evidencia WWOX)
IL-1 axis agents in febrile-infection or cryptogenic refractory epilepsy: acute seizure-control reports in uncontrolled reviews (up to 73 percent within two weeks in 75 pooled patients), no demonstrated long-term benefit in a 14-patient series; minocycline in three patients uninformative; a caspase-1 inhibitor phase II result unverifiable at trial level and without effect in a rat infantile-spasms model. Abstract or review level.
Próximo experimento
Wwox-null or neuron-restricted deletion pups with wild-type littermates: GFAP and Iba1 density and area fraction in cortex and hippocampus at P5, P8, P11, P14 and P17 on the same sections, with continuous cortical recording from the earliest feasible age, each animal classed before or after its first spike, vector-treated controls included. The sign before the first spike decides whether glia are a readout, a seizure consequence or a lever. No compound arm is designed.
Estado del experimento
PROPOSED, not run; no measurement of this kind exists in the repository; its absence does not block the computational work; recording from P5 is a feasibility risk

Imprimir esta sección (A4)

Prueba predictiva: una comparación exploratoria de métodos

EXPLORATORIO: un resultado computacional no es eficacia terapéutica

Pregunta
Entre las familias de compuestos del subconjunto piloto, ¿una red externa con signo (o la vía de la firma transcripcional) ordena los compuestos por la oposición observada a un módulo de seis genes de glucólisis/lactato, en contextos neurales LINCS mantenidos fuera del cálculo, mejor que una referencia de solapamiento sin signo?
Métodos
  • REF-1 referencia sin signo: solapamiento de las dianas del compuesto con los reguladores de primer orden de los genes, corregido por frecuencia
  • NET-EXT rete con segno costruita solo da risorse esterne (propagazione, nessun dato WWOX dentro)
  • NET-WWOX la misma red con cuatro aristas HIF1A duplicadas (ya presentes en la red externa; no representa el patrimonio WWOX)
  • SIG vía de la firma transcripcional: oposición del módulo en células de tipo progenitor, evaluada en células de tipo neuronal
Preinscripción
La pregunta, los métodos, los umbrales y los criterios se registraron antes de abrir cualquier valor de evaluación; una enmienda volvió a congelar las entradas, también antes de abrir ninguna. Ningún criterio se modificó después de un resultado.
Universo evaluado
256 familias con 1.239 firmas, elegidas por disponibilidad de datos entre las 595 del subconjunto piloto (40.268 familias en el catálogo): un subconjunto exploratorio, NO un cribado del catálogo.
Umbral registrado y potencia
Umbral rho 0,15; con 256 familias el efecto mínimo detectable es de aproximadamente 0,157: no se excluyen efectos más pequeños. «Ninguna ventaja» significa ninguna ganancia detectable, no que los compuestos no actúen sobre el módulo.

Veredicto por método

ComparaciónVeredictoNúmerosSe reabre si
Red con signo (solo recursos externos) frente a referencia sin signoninguna ventaja demostrada según los criterios preinscritosrho NET-EXT 0,047; rho REF-1 -0,085una medición de respuesta del compuesto en un sistema neural humano sin WWOX, con réplica; potencia a partir del dato de actividad de ChEMBL; fase II de las firmas; un módulo más grande y replicado
Vía de la firma transcripcional frente a referencia sin signoefecto no detectado, no excluidorho SIG 0,143; intervalo de confianza del 90% de SIG, extremo inferior 0,039; intervalo de confianza del 90% de SIG, extremo superior 0,243las mismas condiciones, más una firma más grande de seis genes

El módulo se transfiere a un contraste independiente de pérdida de WWOX (ratón P47T, hipocampo)no concluyentecontraste D del módulo 0,329; percentil 95 de la distribución nula emparejada, aproximadamente 0,39 (extracción del productor) 0,389; p exacto a una cola 0,060; stesso percentile, estrazione del verificatore 0,396un contraste neural humano sin WWOX, replicado, con lectura proteica o de actividad emparejada; una cohorte P47T más grande

Límites

  • Exploratorio: un resultado computacional no es eficacia terapéutica.
  • Células neurales salvajes, no células sin WWOX; nivel del transcrito, no de la actividad.
  • Las familias se eligen por disponibilidad de datos, no por un análisis del catálogo; una sola concentración y pocas mediciones en el tiempo.
  • Ninguna potencia ni exposición tisular entra en ningún método; el umbral registrado es rho 0,15 y el efecto mínimo detectable es aproximadamente 0,157: no se excluyen efectos más pequeños.
  • El módulo no está demostrado como rasgo reproducible de la pérdida de WWOX: los resultados sobre los compuestos no tienen relevancia WWOX demostrada.

No se muestra ninguna probabilidad clínica calibrada, porque ninguna ha sido validada; el percentil del modelo no se muestra en absoluto.

Comparación entre contextos: concordancias y discordancias entre los sistemas con pérdida de WWOX

Para cada cantidad, qué muestran los sistemas en los que se ha perdido WWOX. Nivel del transcrito salvo donde se indique; los contextos son más numerosos que los modelos independientes.

182 celdas (13 contextos × 14 cantidades): 93 con una medición o un dato reportado y 89 desconocidas. Las desconocidas son lagunas, no ceros. Contando los modelos y no las columnas, los sistemas independientes son aproximadamente 6.

Ningún subgrupo de pacientes está respaldado por estos datos: ninguna etiqueta de respuesta, ningún grupo computacional ofrecido como biomarcador. Los contextos son sistemas modelo, no pacientes.

La lectura se deriva de la regla, no se asigna a mano. Discordante: signos resueltos de dirección opuesta. Concordante: el mismo signo resuelto en al menos dos modelos y ninguno opuesto. Un solo sistema: signo resuelto en un solo modelo. Ningún signo resuelto: las celdas medidas están todas dentro del ruido. Sin datos: no hay ninguna medición. Un signo es «resuelto» solo si es distinguible del ruido con el criterio de la fuente, y se cuentan los modelos, no las columnas. La lectura prudente del documento original puede ser más cauta: la nota de cada fila lo indica.

Imprimir esta sección (A4)

Explorar: necesidad, mecanismo, compuestos e intervenciones, evidencia, siguiente pregunta

Cada fila sigue una necesidad biológica: qué se ha observado, qué mecanismo se podría mover, qué fichas de candidato lo tienen como diana, qué evidencia hay y qué pregunta viene después. Los filtros valen para esta sección, para las fichas, para las prioridades y para la comparación.

?

País: la evidencia de acceso procede en parte de fuentes estadounidenses (openFDA, DSLD) y en parte de fuentes no específicas de un país (ChEMBL, MATRIX); ningún otro país se ha consultado directamente, por lo que el filtro separa únicamente «evidencia de acceso encontrada» de «ninguna obtenida». Objetivo: el de una necesidad es propio de la necesidad; el de una ficha es el propósito escrito en la ficha, y ambos pueden diferir.

Fichas de candidatos (0 mostradas)

Cada ficha responde brevemente a seis preguntas; los detalles técnicos y las tablas completas están un clic más abajo. Los tipos de evidencia nunca se fusionan: un experimento WWOX en un sistema DEE, la biología de WWOX en otro contexto, un precedente de otra enfermedad, un resultado computacional y una hipótesis no verificada tienen etiquetas propias.

Selección.

Prioridades de investigación: qué estudiar más y por qué

Se trata de una agrupación según el motivo por el que un estudio resulta interesante, no de un orden de fichas ni de una clasificación de eficacia: el número de publicaciones, de vías biológicas afectadas o una celda L4 no intervienen. Cada vínculo candidato-necesidad tiene su propia posición: hipótesis favorable (F), evidencia contraria por aclarar (C) o premisa faltante (P). El orden de las posiciones es una agrupación por tipo de motivo; dentro de una posición el orden es alfabético y carece de significado. Los criterios cumplidos y no cumplidos se imprimen con cada posición.

Plan de verificaciones por necesidad

Una lista por necesidad, en el orden del registro de necesidades: no es una secuencia de trabajo, no es una clasificación de necesidades ni de tratamientos y no tiene puntuación. Para cada necesidad: el motivo del siguiente estudio (verificar una hipótesis, aclarar una contraevidencia o resolver una premisa, coherente con las posiciones F, C, P de la necesidad), una línea en español, la pregunta, los datos que podrían resolverla, qué cambiaría y la viabilidad realmente conocida («no conocida» cuando no lo es).

Restaurar la proteína WWOX en las neuronas mediante la adición del gen NEED-WWOX-GENE-ADDITION

Motivo del siguiente estudio: verificare un'ipotesi Posiciones de la necesidad: F1F2

En breve. Aclarar si la adición del gen beneficia solo si se administra en los primeros días de vida (prevención) o también después de la aparición del fenotipo, y si la dosis intermedia distingue umbral de gradiente.

Pregunta. Does an intermediate vector level separate a threshold from a gradient, and is the benefit only prevented inside the first days of life or also recovered when treatment follows onset? No study has measured the phenotype at the day of injection.

Ventana de intervención:
  • prevención (ventana temprana) Mouse: every endpoint is read after treatment at P0 to P5 in animals never measured before it.
  • recuperación tras el inicio (solo en un modelo) Only organoid hyperexcitability: AAV9 given at week 10 on a phenotype recorded at week 7 (post-onset by about 3 weeks, in different organoid cohorts), read at week 16 only; persistence not measured; one endpoint family; radial-glia abnormalities not corrected.
  • no medido Any mouse treatment after P5, a pre-treatment baseline, reversibility.
Detalles: datos, efecto, viabilidad
Datos que podrían resolverla
The cards' own next measurement: an intermediate arm defined as a fraction of the higher level, carried to 300 days with survival, weight, glucose, ECoG and quantified myelination; plus a pre-treatment baseline in the same animals or an age-matched cohort, and treated-after-onset arms with a same-age untreated comparator (organoids or a slower-onset model). Added in IT8: a post-onset arm in organoids with a same-organoid baseline and an AAV9 vector control, severe and milder variant classes side by side. External precedents (batch ORCH-SCIBATCH-DR-20261105): the added arm should be worded per endpoint class and should measure the restoration actually achieved at the age of treatment and its regional distribution, because the one comparable later-age failure in a short-lived null was left uninterpretable by that missing measurement; carry a within-animal pre-treatment recording, a treated wild-type or heterozygote arm, growth and glycaemia as primary endpoints (growth failed even with pre-onset treatment in the closest analogue), and follow-up long enough to see decay. Quantified myelin sheath structure (g-ratio or electron microscopy, not marker intensity) is the discriminating endpoint for a neuron-driven lesion: white-matter abnormality has been reversed after a documented onset only in glial or metabolic lesions, and sheath structure after onset has been reported only in a metabolic oligodendrocyte-enzyme lesion (G-ratio by electron microscopy, one source) and not in any neuron-driven lesion. Spike-wave rate is the confirmatory endpoint and its external precedent is split, so pair it with a rhythm or power-spectrum measure; interneuron number as well as excitability, because no source measured number.
Qué cambiaría
Quantified myelination would add a controlled row on the same need; a failure would move the card to C2 by rule; a treated-after-onset arm would show whether the word recovery may be used for that endpoint. A post-onset arm that moved a circuit readout but not quantified sheath structure would match the precedents. The reverse pattern would be the first of its kind for a neuron-driven lesion measured as sheath structure, not the first outright. Either would need the locator audit before it touched a card.
Viabilidad (solo lo conocido)
Laboratorio con el vector y un ratón Wwox-nulo; ninguno conocido en el repositorio. Si el vector se puede obtener: no conocido.
Wet-lab work in a Wwox-null mouse by a laboratory that has the vector; none known in this repository; the source laboratory is one group (the two papers share a senior author). Whether the vector is obtainable: not known. External precedents sharpen rather than relieve the problem: no external post-onset arm treats an animal with the lifespan of this null; two external sources treated nulls with short lives later with a modest survival benefit (abstract level), so a vector contribution to the perinatal-only window is possible and unmeasured.

Además (IT9 P6): un experimento condicional sobre el eje HIF (proteína HIF-1alfa y HIF-2alfa en las células neurales sin WWOX, luego knockdown genético y una palanca de clase PX-478 frente a un control de dirección), propuesto y no ejecutado. Restante (IT10 P2.1/P5): la dirección del cambio de HIF no está establecida (condicional); control genético primero; oxígeno fisiológico al 5% como condición primaria; brazos por actividad, MYC y estado de cultivo. IT12: en el cerebro P47T adulto (solo transcritos) el desplazamiento es amplio y modesto, impulsado por las enzimas glucolíticas, y no reproduce el perfil selectivo del organoide; se mantienen separadas tres hipótesis (estado del organoide, actividad, composición); añadidos anclaje in vivo y panel génico.

Pregunta. Is PDH phosphorylation higher in WWOX-deficient neural cells, and does a PDK inhibitor change it in a genotype-dependent way without lowering glucose in a hypoglycaemic model?

Detalles: datos, efecto, viabilidad
Datos que podrían resolverla
The closing condition of card I01: PDHA1 Ser293 phosphorylation, total PDH, activity and a tracer experiment, genotype by inhibitor; a glycaemia arm in the constitutive knockout, where glucose at P10 is already about 95 against about 130. IT7 P6 2026-10-29: decisive measurement unchanged; read PDK1, LDHA, LDHB, HK2, SLC2A1 and BNIP3 transcripts beside it in the same cells, so the replicated WWOX-deficient human neural contrast that the P3 comparison named as missing is also a second transfer test; no computational ranking selects the compound arm. (IT7 P6: the network routes added no value and the signature route was not detected, not excluded.) IT8 P3 2026-10-29, restated IT9 P4a 2026-10-30: a nanomolar pan-isoform inhibitor is added alongside dichloroacetate for the genotype-by-inhibitor arm, because dichloroacetate inhibits the recombinant human kinase isoforms only at about 0.1 to above 5 millimolar in curated database rows and a null with it alone at cell-attainable concentrations would be uninterpretable, whereas in the one document that measured both on all four isoforms the inhibitor acts at about 20 to 170 nanomolar; caveats: pan-isoform (no isoform attribution), availability for research use not stated by the sources, neuronal engagement and brain exposure not shown, second-isoform assay on a different substrate. IT9 P6 2026-10-30 (card K01): the HIF axis upstream of PDK1 is a separate, conditional experiment that can share cells and lysates with this one: HIF-1alpha and HIF-2alpha protein in WWOX-deficient versus corrected human neural cells first (never measured; nuclear and cytoplasmic fractions, normoxia and hypoxia), then genetic HIF1A and EPAS1 knockdown and a PX-478-class lever, with a genetic-first arm C (VHL or EGLN1 loss; a prolyl-hydroxylase inhibitor only beside HIF-null and prolyl-hydroxylase-null controls, direction conditional (H-protect), not a 'mimic' of a disease direction) in knockout and corrected cells; deciding readout lactate or acidification and glucose uptake plus PGK1, ALDOA, ENO1, PFKP and PKM individually (the six readout genes and the 10-gene set are guard-scope members: a change there confirms the seed, it does not validate a lever), with network activity and viability giving the valence; the arms are conditional on the HIF-dependent shift being adaptive or harmful. IT10 P5 2026-10-31 (restated after IT10 P2.1): step 0 is run at 5 percent oxygen (physioxia) as the primary condition beside 21 and 1 percent, with a hypoxia marker and size matching in any organoid arm, an activity-silenced arm and a MYC loss-of-function arm for the rival explanations, a multielectrode network-activity readout, and two independent knockout clones with isogenic add-back. Reopenable searches from the genetic-interaction screen GSE298081 (one unreplicated clone; association only): a second clone or re-expression screen, a neural genetic-interaction readout including LDHA, PDHA1, SLC2A1, HK2 and HIF1A, a DepMap bulk test, a ChEMBL retry (triggers NP1B1 to NP1B4).

A genotype-by-inhibitor interaction would give the first WWOX-system row for DCA on this need; the known glucose-lowering and neuropathy signals would remain as tags. A computational ranking of compounds does not change this: the IT7 P3 comparison found no added value for the network routes and an effect not detected, not excluded for the signature route, so the kind of study and the position of the need are unchanged. A null with dichloroacetate alone is not read as absence of a PDK effect. The HIF experiment (card K01) would change a different decision: a negative premise measurement drops the HIF axis for neural cells; knockdown that lowers lactate while viability or differentiation worsen marks the shift as adaptive and drops the lever; the opposite marks it harmful and gives the first WWOX-system row for the lever (F3 to F2 by rule); lactate falling with viability, network activity and differentiation unchanged or discordant leaves the valence unresolved. It does not change the position of the PDK arm of this need. IT12: nothing here moves the position; a protein-level HIF datum in P47T tissue or in human neural cells that separates activity, composition and a WWOX-specific effect would.

Ganancia excitatoria de red y descargas en ráfagas NEED-EXCITATORY-GAIN-GLUTAMATE-RECEPTOR

Motivo del siguiente estudio: verificare un'ipotesi Posiciones de la necesidad: F2F3P3

En breve. Aclarar cuál de tres lecturas explica el estallido de actividad en los cortes (ganancia de NMDAR, dependencia permisiva, impulso de AMPAR) y si depende del bloqueo por magnesio; primero se necesita la corriente NMDAR aislada (E1). IT13: se necesitan brazos WT+WWOX y WWOX mutado (muerto), el organoide como unidad, a ciegas, y dos silenciadores independientes con lavado; la descarga por sí sola sigue siendo sintomática.

Pregunta. Which of three readings (NMDAR gain, permissive necessity, AMPAR-led drive) explains the d-APV-sensitive bursting, and does the bursting depend on the magnesium block? The d-APV result alone does not separate them.

Detalles: datos, efecto, viabilidad
Datos que podrían resolverla
Card F04, step E1: the isolated NMDAR current under voltage control (AMPAR and GABA-A blocked) in knockout, heterozygote and wild-type slices: amplitude, decay, NMDA:AMPA ratio, GluN2B and GluN2A shares, resting potential and input resistance; then concentration-response of d-APV and of a GluN2B-selective tool, and a use-dependent pore blocker (memantine as a translation probe, with Mg2+ and holding potential stated). Card P11: a graded bath-Mg2+ titration in the source medium with d-APV as ceiling, the composition of the recording bath, and serum and cerebrospinal-fluid Mg in the knockout mouse. The graded memantine against perampanel design of card F01 is superseded as discriminator by F04. Added in IT13 (P3b): the only human firing recovery (PMID 42397075 Fig 6) needs a wild-type + WWOX arm and a mutant WWOX arm (WW1-dead and an SDR-region mutant, with construct expression, stability and localisation shown, since a mutant is not necessarily inactive for every WWOX function) to separate recovery from a transgene effect, the organoid as the unit of testing (not ROIs or fields), at least two differentiations, an assessor blind to arm, and two independent silencers (a sodium-channel blocker and an NMDAR antagonist, with a 2-week washout) read on firing and on the CTIP2/SATB2 fraction together: read the effect against the exposure that is still active (a compound can be withdrawn, an AAV transgene keeps being expressed), and report apart an acute effect on an endpoint, a functional benefit during exposure, compensation of an impaired function, a change that persists after a compound is withdrawn, and broader recovery of WWOX functions; a reduction of firing needs controls against toxicity, cell loss and generalised suppression of activity (viability, cell number, preserved evoked responses) before it is read as a functional improvement (see the corrected bench protocol sheet). Added in IT13 (P3a): in the same neuron-deleted slices, resting potential and the M-current (Kv7) component, the isolated NMDAR current and sIPSC, littermate controls and animals as units, matched-trigger wild-type slices, a GluN2B negative allosteric modulator concentration-response beside d-APV and a Kv7 opener with reversal by an M-current blocker (prediction per reading in the design notes): a state that is secondary to illness, myelin or maturation would predict no lever. IT15 refinement: the quantity to measure is the GluN2B-sensitive share of the isolated NMDAR current (a saturating GluN2B negative modulator in the same cells). The expected current fall of a GluN2B modulator is an upper bound (incomplete inhibition, triheteromers), so burst scoring is read against an equal-current titration of a competitive glutamate-site antagonist and a low-trapping pore blocker, with a GluN2A modulator and a second, chemically unrelated GluN2B modulator as controls; a steeper-than-linear burst fall is not a discriminator alone because burst generation is threshold-like. Pore blockers show no subunit selectivity detected in recombinant-receptor data, which are not slice values.
Qué cambiaría
E1 decides whether an NMDAR gain is present or the dependence is permissive; a partial blocker is read only after E1, and without E1 a memantine result cannot be attributed to pyramidal receptors. A titration that cannot lower bursts inside a reachable range closes the magnesium strand. A silencer that lowers firing without raising CTIP2/SATB2 would be read as separating the two readouts (and as symptomatic only if the controls show generalised suppression); one that raises the markers would be read as an activity-dependent route to the marker readout; lowered firing in wild type + WWOX would limit how much of the add-back effect is attributed to recovery, without cancelling the result in the knockout.
Viabilidad (solo lo conocido)
Electrofisiología en cortes del knockout neurona-específico del artículo original: la línea no está disponible aquí, si se puede obtener no se conoce; magnesio: etiquetas de EE. UU. por nombre, Italia no verificada.
Slice electrophysiology in the neuron-specific knockout of the original paper; the line is not held here and whether it is obtainable is not known. Magnesium products have US label evidence by name only; Italy was not checked.

Control inhibitorio NEED-INHIBITORY-HYPOFUNCTION

Motivo del siguiente estudio: resolver una premisa Posiciones de la necesidad: P1P3

En breve. Aclarar si la pérdida de inhibición GABA-A rápida es el paso que produce las descargas en el corte del knockout neuronal, o si las explican mejor una ganancia excitadora, una despolarización graduada compartida o un estado secundario; el heterocigoto comparte la despolarización pero descarga mucho menos.

Pregunta. In the Wwox neuron-deleted neocortical slice, is the lost fast GABA-A inhibition the step that makes bursting (rather than a graded change of resting potential and input resistance, an excitatory gain, or a secondary state)? The heterozygote shares the input-resistance change and is intermediate in resting potential, yet it bursts far less (4 of 23 slices against 36 of 42); the source tests heterozygote against knockout for sIPSC amplitude and frequency (7 heterozygote cells from 4 animals) but reports no heterozygote-versus-wild-type test and no heterozygote mean.

Detalles: datos, efecto, viabilidad
Datos que podrían resolverla
Same-cell triad in knockout, heterozygote and Cre-positive wild-type slices: isolated NMDAR current, sIPSC charge with physiological chloride (the source used a KCl internal solution), miniature IPSCs in TTX as the locus readout, and resting potential with input resistance; then, in wild-type and heterozygote slices, a sufficiency matrix (titrate one deficit at a time to its knockout-measured size and ask which gives NMDAR-dependent bursts), then single-mechanism corrections in knockout slices with viability, action-potential height and washout as requirements, the firing-current curve and input resistance measured and reported, and the effect in wild-type slices as a specificity qualifier (not a condition for partial benefit). The animal is the unit; slices from one animal are not independent, and no sample size is fixed here because the variance is not known (see the design notes of the research package).
Qué cambiaría
A heterozygote with inhibition like the knockout would put the NMDAR/excitatory-gain readings first; a knockout-specific receptor-limited loss would make positive modulation of GABA-A receptors a probe-level compensation hypothesis (subtype selectivity of the candidate agents is disputed across three primary papers); a release-limited loss would favour GABA reuptake inhibition as the contrast; a secondary state would predict no lever. None of these outcomes is a treatment claim.
Viabilidad (solo lo conocido)
Electrofisiología en cortes del knockout neurona-específico del laboratorio de origen: la línea no está disponible aquí, si se puede obtener no se conoce.
Slice electrophysiology in the neuron-specific knockout of the source laboratory; the line is not held here and whether it is obtainable is not known; source data of the published recordings would settle part of it.

Motivo del siguiente estudio: chiarire una controevidenza Posiciones de la necesidad: C2C3F2F3P1P3

En breve. Aclarar si el efecto tardío de la ethosuximide es reproducible con una prueba fármaco por genotipo, si el litio es específico del genotipo y si los denominadores de las series de casos (dieta cetógena, vigabatrin) mantienen la posición C2.

Pregunta. Is the ethosuximide late-phase effect reproducible with a drug-by-genotype test and a same-day control, is the lithium effect genotype-specific, and do the denominators of the ketogenic-diet and vigabatrin case series keep their C2?

Detalles: datos, efecto, viabilidad
Datos que podrían resolverla
Next measurements of cards EB-ETX-01, G01 and H01: a concurrent same-day PTZ-alone control in all genotypes, an interaction test, plasma and brain exposure; for the case-level drugs, the denominators (children placed on the diet; hormonal therapy during MRI changes). IT13 (P3a): the two PTZ-alone null cohorts in the published figure differ by about the size of the ethosuximide effect, which is why a concurrent same-day control is the first requirement. Status 2026-11-05/06 (A1): the diet denominator is still not stated. At least 3 children were exposed; patients 3 and 5 have no diet entry; the narratives of patients 1-4 are not reachable. Vigabatrin MRI exposure is 2 of 2 at abstract level in a report selected for the finding, so it is not a denominator of exposed children. The same group's 64-child cohort (PMID 42735667) gives 18 of 64 with the abnormality, 9 of the 18 of genetic aetiology; the two children are probably inside it.
Qué cambiaría
A reproduced interaction would give an F1 on the T-type and seizure needs; a not-reproduced one gives C1. For the diet and vigabatrin the denominators decide whether C2 stays.
Viabilidad (solo lo conocido)
Experimento ya publicado por un solo laboratorio; animales y línea no disponibles (no conocido). Denominadores en poder de los autores de las series; contacto fuera de alcance.
The mouse experiment is the one already published by one laboratory; animals and the Wwox-null line are not available here (not known). Denominators: with the case-series authors; contact is out of scope for this repository and not attempted.

Hipomielinización NEED-MYELINATION

Motivo del siguiente estudio: chiarire una controevidenza Posiciones de la necesidad: C3P1P3

En breve. Aclarar si vigabatrin o CPP-115 añaden daño a la mielina en un modelo juvenil sin Wwox.

Pregunta. Does vigabatrin or CPP-115 exposure add myelin injury in a Wwox-deficient juvenile model, given the baseline white-matter loss in the human cases?

Detalles: datos, efecto, viabilidad
Datos que podrían resolverla
Card H02 next measurement, with the exposure series written as windows rather than levels. Three start windows in a juvenile model that survives them (before the onset of myelination, at its steepest phase, and after its peak), each with a matched vehicle arm in both genotypes, one exposure level carried unchanged across windows, a recovery arm at twice the exposure duration after the last administration, and three readouts that the two rat studies show separate: imaging signal change including a quantitative measure, since the qualitative images normalised in the immature rat while regional T2 did not; vacuolation on electron microscopy, which resolved incompletely in the adult rat; and myelin content by g-ratio with a myelin protein, which recovered only partially in the immature rat. The human record covers imaging alone. Confirmed brain exposure in both genotypes, blinded reading, and a pre-planned genotype-by-window interaction test. A receptor-subtype arm is worth adding, because GABA-A and GABA-B engagement move myelination in opposite directions. The dog and rat start-age evidence that motivates the windows is abstract level only, so the series tests it rather than assuming it.
Qué cambiaría
A clean absence of added injury would move H02 to a position without harm rows; its presence would make the sibling tag a card-level C3 for vigabatrin as well.
Viabilidad (solo lo conocido)
Trabajo en animales; la línea con deleción específica de neuronas no está disponible (no conocida); denominadores de RM solo a nivel de resumen (2 de 2 expuestos, en un informe seleccionado por el hallazgo; frecuencia, no riesgo atribuible); el denominador de una cohorte de 64 niños probablemente los incluye, sin verificar.
Animal work; the neuron-specific deletion line is not held here (not known). Human MRI denominators at abstract level: 2 of 2 exposed children had the change, in a report selected for the finding. The full text is not reachable by an open route: no PMC record, and the publisher refuses automated access. The same group's 64-child vigabatrin cohort gives 18 of 64 with the abnormality and 9 of the 18 of genetic aetiology. Not available: age band at exposure, duration class, and hormonal co-therapy at the change in these two children. A human denominator route exists that needs no new measurement: four cohorts report aetiology class against the imaging abnormality, so a structured count of WWOX-DEE children exposed, imaged and followed could be read against the published aetiology strata and against the unexposed comparators rather than a single pooled rate; such counts give frequency in selected cohorts, not attributable risk in WWOX.

En breve. Aclarar si la actividad de GSK3 está realmente aumentada cuando falta WWOX (hoy solo hay un blot de fosfo-Ser9) y en qué dirección cada clase de inhibidor desplaza la vía Wnt; los compuestos encontrados son herramientas para este experimento, no candidatos.

Pregunta. Is GSK3 output actually raised in WWOX loss, and in which direction does each class of GSK3 inhibitor move the Wnt readout? Detalles: datos, efecto, viabilidad
Datos que podrían resolverla
In Wwox-null (or neuron-deleted) cells or tissue: GSK3 kinase activity and Tau phosphorylation at the GSK3 sites (S396/S404) beside beta-catenin phosphorylation (S33/S37/T41) and AXIN2/LEF1, comparing an ATP-site inhibitor, lithium, and an irreversible non-ATP-competitive inhibitor, with an Axin-pathway control that itself needs GSK3. The animal or culture is the unit; no sample size is fixed here because the variance is not known.
Qué cambiaría
Raised output with a Tau-versus-catenin separation by one class would make that class a compensation hypothesis independent of residual WWOX protein; unchanged output would remove the premise; a rise of the Wnt readout under inhibition would count against GSK3 inhibition in the organoid context. None of these outcomes is a treatment claim.

Mediciones bioquímicas en tejido o células de los laboratorios de origen; el material no está disponible aquí.

Aumento de MYC y desplazamiento del estado de los progenitores en la glía radial sin WWOX NEED-MYC-PROGENITOR-PROLIFERATION

Motivo del siguiente estudio: chiarire una controevidenza Posiciones de la necesidad: C2F3

En breve. Aclarar si el aumento de MYC en la glía radial es una causa, un marcador del estado progenitor o una consecuencia del ciclo celular, y si el déficit de marcadores de capa corregido por el gen en las neuronas indica un compartimento alcanzable después del nacimiento.

Pregunta. Is the MYC rise in WWOX-deficient radial glia a driver, a marker of retained progenitor state or a consequence of the cell-cycle shift, and does the layer-marker deficit that neuron-stage add-back restores define a compartment a postnatal lever could reach?

Detalles: datos, efecto, viabilidad
Datos que podrían resolverla
Step 0 (computational, on the deposited single-cell data if access is granted): MYC and POU5F1 difference between knockout and wild-type radial glia within G1/G0 only and within matched potency strata. Step 1 (wet lab, two independent knockout clones and corrected lines): genetic MYC lowering against a cytostatic control, with SOX2+MYC+, pH3+ and NEUN+ fractions and absolute cell counts per organoid, wild-type-plus-compound groups included; A51 and a PIN1 probe as comparison arms only; add-back before week 4 and at week 10 with MYC and CTIP2/SATB2 readouts; the SCAR12 line stratified the same way.
Qué cambiaría
If MYC difference vanishes within cell-cycle and potency strata, MYC is a marker and the need moves to inert for lever purposes. If genetic MYC lowering moves neuronal fractions in knockout beyond corrected cells and cell counts hold, the driver reading advances to a second model and the development question (a prenatal window) becomes the limit. If progenitor-stage add-back lowers MYC while neuron-stage add-back restores layer markers alone, the two compartments are separated and only the neuron compartment is a postnatal target.
Viabilidad (solo lo conocido)
Laboratorio con líneas isogénicas de organoides y una palanca MYC inducible; líneas no disponibles (no conocida); datos de célula única depositados con posible solicitud de acceso.
Wet lab with isogenic human organoid lines and an inducible MYC lever; the lines are not held (not known); the deposited single-cell data may need an access request.

Estado redox y tono de NRF2 (ROS, citocinas Il6/Il1b) NEED-REDOX-NRF2

Motivo del siguiente estudio: verificare un'ipotesi Posiciones de la necesidad: F3

En breve. Aclarar si en las células neurales deficientes en WWOX hay ROS, tono de NRF2 o citocinas (proteína) alterados, y si activar NRF2 cambia la viabilidad o la actividad de red de forma dependiente de NRF2.

Pregunta. In WWOX-deficient versus isogenic corrected human neural cells that include microglia or CNS-macrophage-like cells, are NRF2 target activity, ROS and IL-6/IL-1beta protein different, and does NFE2L2-dependent activation (KEAP1 knockdown, omaveloxolone, dimethyl fumarate, with monomethyl fumarate as a separate comparator, each against NFE2L2 loss) change viability, lipid peroxidation, network activity or cytokine protein more in knockout than in corrected cells?

Detalles: datos, efecto, viabilidad
Datos que podrían resolverla
Step 0: nuclear NRF2 and KEAP1 protein, NQO1 activity, NQO1/HMOX1/GCLM/SRXN1 transcripts, ROS reporter at baseline and after an oxidative challenge, IL-6 and IL-1beta protein after LPS with or without ATP. Step 1: the activation arms above and NFE2L2 knockdown, both genotypes, with MEA network activity and SOX2/NEUN fractions. Guards: GFAP/IBA1 counts are held-out endpoints; the six IT7 readout genes cannot decide. IT11 P2.3 additions: dimethyl and monomethyl fumarate as separate arms; NFE2L2 loss as the dependence control for every compound; off-NRF2 readouts for the fumarates (NF-kB p65 translocation, HCAR2 dependence, GAPDH activity); omaveloxolone over a concentration series spanning the low-nM NRF2-linked window and the hundreds-of-nM NF-kB/JNK/growth window with NQO1 read at each point and free exposure reported; TNF as a discriminator (NRF2-only action predicts no TNF change); an astrocyte-containing challenged arm; clone and batch recorded.
Qué cambiaría
If neither ROS nor NRF2 tone nor cytokine protein differs and activation changes nothing: the axis moves to inert and the card is closed. If ROS is raised and activation corrects it in knockout cells more than in corrected cells (NFE2L2-dependent): arm R advances to a second model; omaveloxolone paediatric limits then become the development question.
Viabilidad (solo lo conocido)
Laboratorio con líneas neurales isogénicas y una fuente de microglía; disponibilidad no conocida.

Comparación entre pocos candidatos

Seleccione de dos a cuatro fichas en las fichas de candidatos. Se muestran solapamientos, cobertura complementaria y acciones opuestas. Compartir una necesidad, o cubrir necesidades distintas, nunca implica sinergia.

Detalles técnicos

Versiones, huellas digitales, comando de regeneración, estados de las fuentes y el cribado completo del catálogo. Están separados de la exploración de arriba, en inglés técnico, son exhaustivos y no están ordenados: no son listas de candidatos.

Esta sección (matriz completa, filtros, fichas de necesidades, registros y datos técnicos) solo está disponible en el idioma original de los datos, el inglés: los filtros, los enlaces y los identificadores funcionan como en los demás idiomas.

Unknown share: 28,234 of 44,211 records (63.9%) have no access evidence in any source queried. Unknown means not obtained, not "not available".

Categories overlap (a record can have OTC and prescription evidence), so the rows above do not sum to the total. Mutually exclusive signatures, which do sum to the total:

Scope. An access category is US evidence found in the sources on the retrieval dates shown under technical details (openFDA NDC listings, NIH DSLD labels matched by normalised name, ChEMBL and MATRIX status flags). It is not an approval, not appropriateness for any person, and not a safety statement. Non-US access was not obtained. Catalogue note: evidence of access in at least one US listing on a date, scoped per entry; not approval, appropriateness or safety, and not access for a given person or country. DSLD: the bulk probe was interrupted; names not probed have NO supplement evidence either way (unknown, not negative).

Not obtained: dietary-supplement status for any compound that was not probed in DSLD, and for all probed ones except by normalised-name match (DSLD labels carry no identifiers); non-US access (EMA, MHRA, PMDA, national lists): no open bulk source was found; US NDC products without a UNII (cannot be linked by identifier); DGIdb newer than the 2024-06-10 TSV release

DispositionPairs (cells)Distinct families or rowsMeaning
consistent mechanism candidate7474direction-consistent action on an intervention target of a direction-evaluable need (a mechanism candidate, not a treatment)

Positive evidence from a working source is not changed by it, and an accessibility-source error never produces it (a stale source adds a caveat instead)

Cells and distinct families are different units: one family can hold several cells (one per need). A count of cells is not a count of compounds.

none: no score, no ordering by evidence volume; filter by disposition, need or criterion. Order is need id then row id.. 602 priority pairs are flagged exploration (need direction uncertain).

Dispositions are distinct: source queried without result (the sources were asked and returned no row for the record), incomplete or failed query (a source was not in state OK; this is never a negative) and not relevant / no catalogue link found and insufficient data (a decision from the data that exist) are different statements and are not merged.

Piste derivate dal catalogo e loro disposizioni

Curated, reasoned endings of catalogue searches (iteration 3, closed-loop demonstration, scientist-b, 2026-10-28). Read by un registro del repositorio (no incluido en este paquete) handoff. A disposition is a decision about a search, not a claim about biology and not a ranking. Coverage version used: main 315cd50c (before the ABAT / GtoPdb artefact correction of task/it3-search2).

A catalogue target listing (a stated action, or none) is a source statement, not a recommendation. Reasoned endings of searches, including abstentions and opposite mechanisms, each with what would reopen it. Limiti dichiarati

  • Association is not modulation, and modulation is not rescue. A headline link (L1) is a source statement about a target; it says nothing about a change in a WWOX-deficient system.
  • No efficacy is shown or implied. L3 is an assertion listed as pertinent to the need, with its sign and scope (other-disease precedent, enzyme or cell-free engagement and safety signals are separate states); L4 is a technical comparison against the disease change in a WWOX system, not efficacy and not safety.
  • Scores are not probabilities. There is no score or probability in this view. Dispositions are reasoned categories; the order is need id then row id, not evidence volume. Any model score elsewhere in the module is not a probability.
  • Combinations are not inferred. No synergy, complementarity or joint effect is computed; sets of compounds are not scored.
  • Exploration lists. For the 14 needs whose direction is uncertain, L2 is not evaluable and the compound list is for exploration, not a list of favourable treatments.
  • Access is US evidence, dated; not approval, appropriateness or safety. Unknown is not negative. Safety is NOT_ASSESSED for every family; potency is not carried.
  • A family is not a drug. Records are source-level substance records (salts, stereoisomers and source-only rows count once each); name twins are not merged.
  • Pertinence is listed by hand per assertion; an assertion not in the pertinence table is not counted. Absence in cards (none in cards) is not a negative finding. Seizure-need cells are symptom-level inferences. Role rows carry certainty qualifiers.
  • Public disease and reference-genotype level only. Nothing here is medical advice.

Source limits recorded by the module: catalogue links are source statements; no potency is carried; DGIdb is a STALE export (2024-06-10); current service coverage not ingested; ChEMBL non-human target rows are set aside, not matched; pertinence of an assertion to a need is judged in un registro del repositorio (no incluido en este paquete) (a curated input, reviewable); unlisted assertions are not counted; L4 is a technical bridge comparison, not efficacy; case_level = uncontrolled clinical report; needs' own WWOX observations are not interventions and fill no compound cell; seizure-need cells are symptom-level inferences, not mechanism-linked to WWOX; GRIN and T-type couplings rest on one experiment each
